answer_1.quote: we followed a fine-tuning approach using the full transformer architecture from the T5 model family to perform MWE lemmatization in Polish.

answer_2.quote: We have used the same metrics as in PolEval task..., which are case-sensitive accuracy (AccCS) and case-insensitive accuracy (AccCI).

answer_4.quote: Discrepancies between model output and reference data were manually reviewed.
answer_4.guideline: Manual review to identify and categorize errors such as inflection, capitalization, number, and gender discrepancies.
